question: The Arjuna Award is given in the area of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sports**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Arjuna Award** is presented to recognize outstanding achievement in **national sports**.
 
• It was established in **1961** by the Government of India.
 
• The award includes a **bronze statuette of Arjuna**, a certificate, and a cash prize.
 
• It aims to encourage athletes to excel and bring glory to the country through their performance and dedication.
 
• Recipients of the Arjuna Award are selected based on their performance over the previous four years, as well as their contribution to the sport.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The awards were expanded in 1977 to include indigenous games and the physically handicapped category.
 
• In 2001, the criteria for the award were modified to include performance at the international level and leadership qualities.
 
• Other major sports awards in India include the **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna**, **Dronacharya Award**, and the **Dhyan Chand Award**.
 
• The **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports** is responsible for the administration and selection process of the Arjuna Award.
